```ruby title="Ruby"

result = LiterLlm.chat_stream(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(messages: [{ 'content' => 'Count to 3', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'ollama/qwen2:0.5b', stream: true)).to_a
puts result.inspect
```
